text: The King was stung. He said sharply-- “Ye mannerless vagrants, is this your recognition of the royal boon I have promised?” He said more, with angry voice and excited gesture, but it was lost in a whirlwind of laughter and mocking exclamations. ‘John Hobbs’ made several attempts to make himself heard above the din, and at last succeeded--saying-- “Mates, he is my son, a dreamer, a fool, and stark mad--mind him not--he thinketh he is the King.” “I am the King,” said Edward, turning toward him, “as thou shalt know to thy cost, in good time. Thou hast confessed a murder--thou shalt swing for it.” “Thou’lt betray me?--thou? An’ I get my hands upon thee--” “Tut-tut!” said the burley Ruffler, interposing in time to save the King, and emphasising this service by knocking Hobbs down with his fist, “hast respect for neither Kings nor Rufflers?
